title: Remittance Standard — Booking-Day Customer Payments on Arrearage Management Program Bills
content:
# Remittance Standard — Booking-Day Customer Payments on Arrearage Management Program Bills

**Standard.** When a program bill of an Arrearage Management Program plan, the forgiveness kind of Payment Arrangement, is booked as missed, the recognised customer booking-day payments are:

1. the customer payments posted on the booking day through an authorized pay station, whose receipts post the business day after they are taken, and by mailed check, whose postmark is honoured — when no returned-payment charge was posted to the Electric Service Agreement within the returned-payment look-back of its rate schedule;
2. the pay-station payments alone — when at least one returned-payment charge but fewer than the rate schedule's returned-payment restriction count were posted within that look-back, since a mailed check from such an agreement is recognised only once it has cleared;
3. zero — when the restriction count was reached, since an agreement under the returned-payment restriction is given no posting courtesy.

A card, online or autopay payment posted on the booking day was made after the cure period and is never recognised.

The look-back and the restriction count are those of the rate schedule of the Electric Service Agreement; the payments read are the Electric Service Agreement's payments posted on the booking day and the channel each came through.

## Decision table (hypothetical booking day: $50.00 at an authorized pay station, $30.00 mailed check, $20.00 by card)

| Returned-payment charges within the rate schedule's look-back | Recognised customer booking-day payments |
|---|---|
| None | $80.00 (pay station and mailed check) |
| At least one, fewer than the restriction count | $50.00 (pay station alone) |
| Restriction count reached | $0.00 |

The $20.00 card payment is never recognised.
